Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_124765.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: origen_124765.v · Open raw
module origen_124765 #(
    parameter aw = 19
) (
    // Wishbone interface
    input wire wb_clk_i,
    input wire wb_rst_i,
    input wire [31:0] wb_dat_i,
    input wire [aw-1:0] wb_adr_i,
    input wire [3:0] wb_sel_i,
    input wire wb_we_i,
    input wire wb_cyc_i,
    input wire wb_stb_i,
    output reg [31:0] wb_dat_o,
    output reg wb_ack_o,
    output reg wb_err_o,

    // Right SRAM bank interface (16-bit)
    output reg r0_wen,
    output reg r1_wen,
    output reg r_oen,
    output reg r_cen,
    input wire [15:0] r_d_i,
    output reg [15:0] r_d_o,
    output reg [aw-2:0] r_a,

    // Left SRAM bank interface (8-bit)
    output reg l0_wen,
    output reg l1_wen,
    output reg l_oen,
    output reg l_cen,
    input wire [7:0] l_d_i,
    output reg [7:0] l_d_o,
    output reg [aw-2:0] l_a,

    // Common data output enable
    output reg d_oe
);

    localparam MAX_ADDRESS = 20'h200000; // 2MB

    reg [1:0] state;
    localparam IDLE = 2'b00, READ = 2'b01, WRITE = 2'b10, ERROR = 2'b11;

    always @(posedge wb_clk_i or posedge wb_rst_i) begin
        if (wb_rst_i) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            wb_ack_o <= 1'b0;
            wb_err_o <= 1'b0;
            r0_wen <= 1'b1;
            r1_wen <= 1'b1;
            l0_wen <= 1'b1;
            l1_wen <= 1'b1;
            r_oen <= 1'b1;
            l_oen <= 1'b1;
            r_cen <= 1'b1;
            l_cen <= 1'b1;
            d_oe <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (wb_cyc_i && wb_stb_i) begin
                        if ({1'b0, wb_adr_i} >= MAX_ADDRESS) begin
                            state <= ERROR;
                        end else if (wb_we_i) begin
                            state <= WRITE;
                        end else begin
                            state <= READ;
                        end
                    end
                    wb_ack_o <= 1'b0;
                    wb_err_o <= 1'b0;
                end

                READ: begin
                    if (wb_adr_i[aw-1]) begin
                        // Left SRAM bank (8-bit)
                        l_cen <= 1'b0;
                        l_oen <= 1'b0;
                        l_a <= wb_adr_i[aw-2:0];
                        wb_dat_o <= {24'b0, l_d_i};
                    end else begin
                        // Right SRAM bank (16-bit)
                        r_cen <= 1'b0;
                        r_oen <= 1'b0;
                        r_a <= wb_adr_i[aw-2:0];
                        wb_dat_o <= {16'b0, r_d_i};
                    end
                    d_oe <= 1'b1;
                    wb_ack_o <= 1'b1;
                    state <= IDLE;
                end

                WRITE: begin
                    if (wb_adr_i[aw-1]) begin
                        // Left SRAM bank (8-bit)
                        l_cen <= 1'b0;
                        l_a <= wb_adr_i[aw-2:0];
                        l_d_o <= wb_dat_i[7:0];
                        l0_wen <= ~wb_sel_i[0];
                        l1_wen <= ~wb_sel_i[1];
                    end else begin
                        // Right SRAM bank (16-bit)
                        r_cen <= 1'b0;
                        r_a <= wb_adr_i[aw-2:0];
                        r_d_o <= wb_dat_i[15:0];
                        r0_wen <= ~wb_sel_i[0];
                        r1_wen <= ~wb_sel_i[1];
                    end
                    wb_ack_o <= 1'b1;
                    state <= IDLE;
                end

                ERROR: begin
                    wb_err_o <= 1'b1;
                    wb_ack_o <= 1'b1;
                    state <= IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
